dedupe_keys.name: bayesian state dependent multihazard fragility models

description: This repository publishes R scripts and study data for Bayesian state-dependent fragility models under earthquake and flood sequences. Its README gives the order in which to run the first and second groups of models, identifies plotting scripts and output folders, and records the R environment used for the cited Structural Safety paper. Users supply or adapt the hazard intensity, initial damage state and structural response data; outputs are fitted fragility relationships and diagnostic plots for sequential damage. The published example concerns modelled structural assets, not a complete infrastructure network. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing for the repository. A limitation is that fitted curves depend on the study data and causal assumptions; the scripts were not executed and should not be transferred to other asset classes without calibration. The model can inform damage transitions for buildings, bridges or lifeline components in compound-hazard simulation. No study dataset or output file was downloaded. Geographic coverage follows the structures and hazard sequences used to fit a curve; no fixed region is implied. The related Hazus catalogue platform offers another route to asset-damage assessment, with different assumptions.
inputs: Hazard intensity sequences, prior damage state and structural response data
name: Bayesian state-dependent multihazard fragility models
